patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast hero section with minimal fixed navigation and footer elements, creating an expansive and uncluttered visual field.
Dominant, oversized sans-serif typography for the main content, contrasted with very small, subtle sans-serif for navigation and metadata, emphasizing the hero message.
Strict monochromatic palette of black and white, creating strong visual impact and high contrast for all elements.
The central hero text dynamically replaces itself with a different word as the user scrolls, maintaining its large scale and central position.
The entire visible page acts as a single, dynamic hero section, with no distinct content blocks or traditional scrolling sections, focusing all attention on the changing text.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-viewport hero with a solid dark background and large, white, centered text that fills the screen.
Navigation and footer elements are fixed to the viewport edges, appearing as subtle, high-contrast text that remains visible during scroll.
A scroll-triggered animation (using GSAP, as detected) replaces the main hero text with a new word as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic, impactful headline sequence without page transitions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif for the hero (~10x body text) with very small, light sans-serif for supporting text, creating a dramatic typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with all elements featuring crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, characterized by significant negative space around the central hero text and ample padding for fixed elements, contributing to a minimalist feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its extreme minimalism combined with a bold, full-screen text-replacement animation that serves as the primary content and interaction. It eschews traditional imagery or complex layouts in favor of pure typographic impact and dynamic messaging, making the words themselves the hero.
